Cook the vegetables, cumin and protein ingredients in the measured oil until fully cooked. Serve alongside the flatbreads, with curd separately if listed.
Use separate utensils for raw meat, fish or eggs and cook thoroughly before serving.

recipes.name: Plain dosa with coconut chutney
recipes.description: Plain dosa with coconut chutney, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Soak rice and urad separately, grind and ferment the combined batter until risen.
Roast chana dal and grind with coconut, chilli, salt and water; temper with mustard and a little oil.
Spread thin dosas on a hot pan with the remaining oil and cook through; serve with chutney.

recipes.name: Masala dosa
recipes.description: Masala dosa, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Soak and grind the rice and urad; ferment the batter until risen.
Boil the potato. Temper mustard and curry leaves in part of the oil, soften onion and chilli, then fold in potato, turmeric and salt.
Cook thin dosas with the remaining oil, fill with potato masala and fold.

recipes.name: Neer dosa with chana curry
recipes.description: Neer dosa with chana curry, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Soak rice and blend very finely with water into a thin batter. Soak chickpeas separately overnight and cook thoroughly in fresh water.
Cook onion, tomato, ginger, cumin and turmeric in part of the oil; simmer with the chickpeas and ground coconut.
Pour thin rice batter onto a hot greased pan, cover until set and serve with the curry.

recipes.name: Set dosa with curd
recipes.description: Set dosa with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Soak rice, urad and poha, grind and ferment the batter until risen.
Ladle small thick dosas onto a lightly oiled pan and cook gently on both sides.
Serve the cooked dosas with plain curd.

recipes.name: Onion uttapam
recipes.description: Onion uttapam, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Soak rice and urad, grind and ferment the batter until risen.
Chop the vegetables, chilli and coriander. Spread thick pancakes on a hot greased pan and scatter the topping over them.
Press the topping gently into the batter, turn and cook through on both sides.

recipes.name: Tomato uttapam
recipes.description: Tomato uttapam, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Soak rice and urad, grind and ferment the batter until risen.
Chop the vegetables, chilli and coriander. Spread thick pancakes on a hot greased pan and scatter the topping over them.
Press the topping gently into the batter, turn and cook through on both sides.

recipes.name: Vegetable appe
recipes.description: Vegetable appe, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Soak rice and urad, grind and ferment the batter.
Temper mustard and curry leaves in a little oil; fold into the batter with grated carrot, chopped onion and salt.
Cook small spoonfuls in a greased appe pan, turning until set and browned. Serve curd on the side.

recipes.name: Ven pongal
recipes.description: Ven pongal, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Lightly roast moong, rinse with the rice and cook in plenty of water until very soft.
Heat ghee and toast the cashews, cumin, pepper, ginger and curry leaves.
Stir the tempering and salt through the soft rice and dal; adjust with hot water.

recipes.name: Aval upma
recipes.description: Aval upma, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Rinse poha briefly and let it soften without becoming mushy.
Toast peanuts in the oil, add mustard and curry leaves, then cook onion and carrot.
Fold in the poha and salt, steam gently until hot and finish with lemon juice.

recipes.name: Vegetable semiya upma
recipes.description: Vegetable semiya upma, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Dry-roast the vermicelli until lightly golden.
Temper mustard and curry leaves in oil, toast peanuts and soften the vegetables.
Add measured water and salt, stir in vermicelli and simmer until tender.

recipes.name: Puttu with kadala curry
recipes.description: Puttu with kadala curry, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight, drain and cook thoroughly in fresh water. Simmer with cooked onion, tomato, ginger and spices.
Moisten the rice flour with salted water until it holds together loosely; layer it with grated coconut in a puttu steamer.
Steam until cooked through and serve with the chickpea curry.

recipes.name: Appam with vegetable stew
recipes.description: Appam with vegetable stew, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Soak rice and grind into a smooth batter; ferment with the yeast and a little coconut milk.
Soften onion and ginger in oil, add potato, carrot, peas, pepper and water; simmer until tender and add the remaining coconut milk.
Swirl the batter in an appam pan, cover and cook until the centre is set. Serve with the stew.

recipes.name: Idiyappam with coconut vegetable kurma
recipes.description: Idiyappam with coconut vegetable kurma, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Mix rice flour and a little salt with hot water into a soft dough. Press through an idiyappam mould and steam the nests until cooked.
Cook onion, tomato, ginger, cumin and turmeric in oil; add the vegetables and simmer until tender.
Grind coconut with water, stir it into the curry and simmer briefly. Serve with the steamed noodles.

recipes.name: Akki roti with curd
recipes.description: Akki roti with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Mix rice flour, grated carrot, chopped onion, coriander, chilli and salt with warm water into a soft dough.
Pat thin rounds onto a greased sheet or cool pan, make small holes and cook with the measured oil on both sides.
Serve the cooked rotis with curd.

recipes.name: Thalipeeth with curd
recipes.description: Thalipeeth with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Mix the flours, chopped onion, coriander, cumin and salt with warm water into a soft dough.
Pat flatbreads with small holes on a greased sheet; cook on a hot pan using the measured oil.
Turn and cook through; serve with curd.

recipes.name: Methi thepla with curd
recipes.description: Methi thepla with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the flours, chopped methi, spices, salt and a little curd with water into a pliable dough.
Roll thin theplas and cook on a hot pan, brushing with the measured oil on both sides.
Serve with the remaining curd.

recipes.name: Aloo paratha with curd
recipes.description: Aloo paratha with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Boil and mash potato. Mix the filling with chopped onion, ginger, coriander, chilli and salt.
Knead atta with water, divide and stuff with the filling. Roll gently into flatbreads.
Cook on a hot pan with the measured oil until browned and cooked through; serve curd separately.

recipes.name: Gobi paratha with curd
recipes.description: Gobi paratha with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Grate and squeeze excess moisture from cauliflower. Mix the filling with chopped onion, ginger, coriander, chilli and salt.
Knead atta with water, divide and stuff with the filling. Roll gently into flatbreads.
Cook on a hot pan with the measured oil until browned and cooked through; serve curd separately.

recipes.name: Sattu paratha with curd
recipes.description: Sattu paratha with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Moisten sattu with a little water. Mix the filling with chopped onion, ginger, coriander, chilli and salt.
Knead atta with water, divide and stuff with the filling. Roll gently into flatbreads.
Cook on a hot pan with the measured oil until browned and cooked through; serve curd separately.

recipes.name: Sabudana khichdi
recipes.description: Sabudana khichdi, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Rinse and soak sabudana until the pearls soften, then drain well. Roast and crush peanuts; boil and dice potato.
Toast cumin and chilli in oil, add potato and cook briefly.
Fold in sabudana, peanut and salt; cook gently until translucent and finish with lemon juice.

recipes.name: Baingan bharta with roti
recipes.description: Baingan bharta with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Roast the eggplant until soft, peel and mash. Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and spices in oil, then fold in the eggplant.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Bharli vangi with jowar bhakri
recipes.description: Bharli vangi with jowar bhakri, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Roast and grind peanuts and coconut. Slit small brinjals and fill with the paste; simmer with cooked onion, tomato, spices and tamarind until tender.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Aloo gobi with roti
recipes.description: Aloo gobi with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Cook onion, ginger and cumin in oil. Add tomato, turmeric, diced potato and cauliflower; cover and cook until tender.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Aloo gajar matar with roti
recipes.description: Aloo gajar matar with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Cook onion, tomato and spices in oil. Add diced potato and carrot, cover until nearly tender, then add peas and finish cooking.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Beans poriyal with sambar rice
recipes.description: Beans poriyal with sambar rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Cook toor dal until soft and simmer with tomato, tamarind and spices. Stir-fry chopped beans with mustard and curry leaves, then add coconut. Serve both alongside the rice.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Cabbage poriyal with rasam rice
recipes.description: Cabbage poriyal with rasam rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Cook the dal and simmer its cooking liquid with tomato, tamarind, cumin and pepper for rasam. Stir-fry cabbage with mustard and curry leaves, finish with coconut and serve with dal and rice.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Beetroot poriyal with dal rice
recipes.description: Beetroot poriyal with dal rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Cook moong until soft. Temper mustard and curry leaves in oil; add grated beetroot, cover until tender and finish with coconut. Serve with dal and rice.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Tindora fry with dal rice
recipes.description: Tindora fry with dal rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Cook toor dal until tender. Stir-fry sliced tindora with onion, garlic, cumin, turmeric and chilli until cooked; fold tomato into the dal and serve both with rice.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Lauki chana dal with roti
recipes.description: Lauki chana dal with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Soak chana dal briefly, then cook with cubed lauki until the dal is tender. Add the onion-tomato and spice tempering and simmer.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Turai moong dal with roti
recipes.description: Turai moong dal with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Cook moong and peeled ridge gourd until soft. Temper onion, garlic, tomato and spices in oil, combine and simmer.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Pumpkin erissery with red rice
recipes.description: Pumpkin erissery with red rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soak and cook the black-eyed peas thoroughly. Cook pumpkin with turmeric, stir in peas and ground coconut, then finish with mustard, curry leaves and a little toasted coconut.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Avial with red rice
recipes.description: Avial with red rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Cook the cut vegetables with a little water. Grind coconut, cumin and chilli, fold into the vegetables and warm through. Remove from strong heat, add curd and finish with curry leaves and oil.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Olan with rice
recipes.description: Olan with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soak and cook black-eyed peas thoroughly. Simmer ash gourd with chilli until tender, add the peas and coconut milk and warm gently with curry leaves and oil.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Mor kuzhambu with rice
recipes.description: Mor kuzhambu with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.

Soak and grind chana dal with coconut and cumin. Cook ash gourd until tender, add the paste and simmer; lower the heat and stir in beaten curd and turmeric. Finish with mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Vendakkai pachadi with rice
recipes.description: Vendakkai pachadi with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Slice and pan-cook okra until tender. Grind coconut and chilli, cook the paste briefly, cool slightly and combine with curd and okra. Finish with mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Kerala vegetable stew with rice
recipes.description: Kerala vegetable stew with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soften onion, ginger, cinnamon and pepper in oil. Add the vegetables and water, simmer until tender, then add coconut milk and warm gently.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Mushroom pepper fry with roti
recipes.description: Mushroom pepper fry with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Cook onion, garlic and curry leaves in oil. Add mushrooms and capsicum; cook until tender and their moisture reduces, then add tomato, turmeric and freshly crushed pepper.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Mushroom matar pulao
recipes.description: Mushroom matar pulao, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Rinse the rice and slice the mushrooms and onion.
Cook onion and whole spices in oil, add mushrooms and peas, then stir in rinsed rice and measured water. Cover and cook until the rice is tender.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Vegetable kurma with roti
recipes.description: Vegetable kurma with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Cook onion, tomato, ginger and spices in oil; add the vegetables and simmer until tender. Grind coconut and cashew with water, stir in and simmer briefly.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Baked cabbage kofta with roti
recipes.description: Baked cabbage kofta with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.

Mix squeezed grated cabbage with besan, salt and a little oil, shape and bake until firm and cooked. Cook onion, tomato, ginger and spices into a sauce, stir in curd over low heat and add the kofta shortly before serving.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Dal makhani with rice
recipes.description: Dal makhani with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soak urad and rajma overnight and cook thoroughly until very soft. Simmer slowly with the cooked onion-tomato-spice base, then stir in milk and butter.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Panchmel dal with roti
recipes.description: Panchmel dal with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Soak the chana dal, rinse all five dals and cook together until tender. Add the cooked onion, tomato, ginger and spice tempering and simmer.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Gujarati dal with rice
recipes.description: Gujarati dal with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Cook and whisk toor dal until smooth. Simmer with peanuts, tomato, tamarind, jaggery and ginger; finish with the mustard, cumin and curry-leaf tempering.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Dal dhokli
recipes.description: Dal dhokli, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead atta with a pinch of salt, turmeric, a little oil and water into a firm dough.

Cook toor dal and simmer with tomato, tamarind, peanuts and jaggery. Roll the dough thinly, cut into small pieces and drop into the simmering dal; cook until the dough is tender and finish with tempering.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Dal palak with roti
recipes.description: Dal palak with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Cook masoor until soft. Cook garlic and spices in oil, add onion, tomato and spinach, then combine with the dal and simmer.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Chana dal tadka with rice
recipes.description: Chana dal tadka with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soak chana dal and cook until tender while retaining its shape. Cook onion, ginger, garlic, tomato and spices in oil, then stir through the dal.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Kulthi dal with rice
recipes.description: Kulthi dal with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soak horsegram overnight, drain and cook in fresh water until fully tender. Add the cooked onion-tomato and spice tempering; mash a little dal to thicken.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Lobia masala with rice
recipes.description: Lobia masala with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soak black-eyed peas and cook thoroughly. Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and spices in oil; add the peas and simmer until the sauce thickens.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Green moong usal with jowar bhakri
recipes.description: Green moong usal with jowar bhakri, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Soak whole moong and cook until tender. Cook onion, tomato, coriander seeds and spices, add moong and coconut and simmer.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Matki usal with roti
recipes.description: Matki usal with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Soak moth beans and cook thoroughly until tender. Combine with the cooked onion, tomato, garlic and spice base, add coconut and simmer.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Home-style misal pav
recipes.description: Home-style misal pav, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Soak moth beans overnight. Mix besan with a little water and salt; reserve part of the oil for the topping.

Cook soaked moth beans thoroughly. Simmer with the cooked onion-tomato-spice base and coconut. Toast peanuts; pan-cook a thin besan batter and cut into crisp strips for a homemade topping. Serve the usal with pav, toppings and lemon.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Pitla with jowar bhakri
recipes.description: Pitla with jowar bhakri, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Cook mustard, cumin, garlic, onion and chilli in oil. Whisk besan with water and turmeric, pour in and stir until fully cooked into a thick sauce.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Zunka with bajra bhakri
recipes.description: Zunka with bajra bhakri, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Cook mustard, cumin and onion in oil. Add besan, turmeric and salt; sprinkle water gradually and stir until the flour cooks into soft crumbs. Finish with coriander.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Gatte ki sabzi with bajra roti
recipes.description: Gatte ki sabzi with bajra roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Knead besan with a little oil, salt and water into logs; simmer in water until cooked and slice. Cook the spice base, add beaten curd gently and simmer with the gatte.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Kadhi with baked pakora and rice
recipes.description: Kadhi with baked pakora and rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.

Mix part of the besan with sliced onion, spices and a little oil; shape and bake until cooked. Whisk the remaining besan with curd and water, simmer while stirring until cooked, then add tempering and the pakora.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Sindhi sai bhaji with rice
recipes.description: Sindhi sai bhaji with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soak chana dal and cook with spinach, methi, potato, tomato and turmeric until very tender. Mash lightly and finish with onion, garlic and cumin cooked in oil.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Cholar dal with luchi
recipes.description: Cholar dal with luchi, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead atta with a little oil, salt and water into a firm dough. This home version uses whole-wheat flour and measured oil.

Cook soaked chana dal until tender. Temper cumin and cinnamon with coconut in part of the oil, add dal, raisins and jaggery. Roll small discs of dough and shallow-fry in the remaining measured oil, turning until cooked.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Odia dalma with rice
recipes.description: Odia dalma with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Cook toor with pumpkin, potato, eggplant, ginger and turmeric until tender. Toast and crush some cumin, temper the rest in oil and stir both into the dal with coconut.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Chickpea sundal with lemon rice
recipes.description: Chickpea sundal with lemon rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soak and cook chickpeas thoroughly. Temper mustard, curry leaves and chilli in oil; use part for the chickpeas with coconut and part for the rice with lemon juice.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Chana madra with rice
recipes.description: Chana madra with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soak and cook chickpeas thoroughly. Warm whole spices in ghee, add beaten curd on low heat and stir continuously; add chickpeas and turmeric and simmer gently.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Lemon rice with peanut cucumber raita
recipes.description: Lemon rice with peanut cucumber raita, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, turmeric and peanuts in oil; fold through rice and add lemon juice off the heat. Mix chopped cucumber with curd and serve as raita.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Tamarind rice with curd
recipes.description: Tamarind rice with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Temper mustard, chana dal, peanuts and curry leaves in oil. Add tamarind mixed with water, chilli and salt, simmer until thick and fold through cooked rice.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Coconut rice with boiled chana
recipes.description: Coconut rice with boiled chana, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soak and cook chickpeas thoroughly. Temper mustard, urad, curry leaves and chilli in oil; toast coconut briefly, fold through rice and serve with the cooked chickpeas.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Tomato rice with curd
recipes.description: Tomato rice with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Temper mustard and curry leaves in oil, soften onion and cook tomatoes with turmeric and chilli until thick. Fold through cooked rice and serve curd separately.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Coriander rice with moong dal
recipes.description: Coriander rice with moong dal, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Cook moong until tender. Blend coriander, coconut and chilli with a little water; cook the paste with cumin in oil, fold through rice and finish with lemon.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Mint rice with cucumber raita
recipes.description: Mint rice with cucumber raita, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Blend mint and coriander with a little water. Cook onion and cumin in oil, add peas and the herb paste and cook through; fold in rice. Serve with cucumber mixed into curd.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Peas pulao with raita
recipes.description: Peas pulao with raita, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Rinse rice, slice onion and dice the cucumber.
Cook onion and spices in oil, add peas and rinsed rice, then measured water. Cover until tender and serve with cucumber curd raita.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Vegetable tehri
recipes.description: Vegetable tehri, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Rinse the rice and cut the vegetables into small even pieces.
Cook onion, tomato, ginger and spices in oil. Add vegetables and rinsed rice, then measured water; cover and cook until the rice and vegetables are tender.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Kashmiri-style pulao with curd
recipes.description: Kashmiri-style pulao with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Rinse the rice and finely dice the carrot.
Toast cashews, raisins and whole spices in ghee. Add carrot, peas and rice; cook with milk and enough water until tender. Serve with curd.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Bajra khichdi with curd
recipes.description: Bajra khichdi with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: This flour-based home version uses the catalogue’s bajra flour; mix it with cool water before adding to hot dal.
Cook moong until soft. Whisk bajra flour with water and stir into the simmering dal; cook, stirring, until the flour is fully cooked. Finish with ginger and cumin warmed in ghee.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Paneer tikka with roti
recipes.description: Paneer tikka with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Marinate paneer, capsicum and onion in curd, ginger, garlic and spices. Skewer or spread on a tray, brush with measured oil and roast or grill until hot and lightly browned.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Kadai paneer with roti
recipes.description: Kadai paneer with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Toast and crush coriander seeds and cumin. Cook onion, tomato and ginger in oil, add capsicum and the crushed spices, then paneer and warm through.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Paneer jalfrezi with roti
recipes.description: Paneer jalfrezi with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Stir-fry onion, ginger, carrot and capsicum in oil. Add tomato, spices and paneer strips; cook until the vegetables are tender but retain texture.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Palak tofu with roti
recipes.description: Palak tofu with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Blanch spinach briefly and blend. Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and spices in oil; add the spinach and tofu cubes and simmer gently.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Tofu bhurji with jowar bhakri
recipes.description: Tofu bhurji with jowar bhakri, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Cook onion, tomato, capsicum, peas and spices in oil. Crumble in tofu and stir until hot and the vegetables are cooked.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Tofu peas pulao
recipes.description: Tofu peas pulao, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Rinse rice, dice tofu and slice the onion.
Brown tofu cubes lightly in part of the oil and set aside. Cook onion, cumin and cinnamon, add rice, peas and water and cook until tender; fold in the tofu.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Soybean usal with ragi roti
recipes.description: Soybean usal with ragi roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Soak soybeans overnight, discard soaking water and cook in fresh water until completely tender. Simmer with the cooked onion-tomato-spice base and coconut.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Sattu soy paratha with curd
recipes.description: Sattu soy paratha with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Prepare soy chunks following the packet instructions, squeeze dry and mince. Mix with sattu, chopped onion, ginger, coriander and salt for the filling.
Knead atta with water, stuff with the filling and roll carefully.
Cook on a hot pan with measured oil until cooked through and serve with curd.

recipes.name: Chickpea paneer chaat with roti
recipes.description: Chickpea paneer chaat with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Soak chickpeas overnight and cook thoroughly. Cool slightly, combine with paneer, chopped cucumber, tomato and onion, then dress with curd, lemon, toasted cumin and coriander.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Whole green moong chilla with curd
recipes.description: Whole green moong chilla with curd, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Soak whole moong until softened, drain and blend with ginger, chilli and water into a batter.
Fold in chopped onion, cumin and salt; spread thin pancakes on a hot greased pan.
Cook through on both sides with measured oil and serve with curd.

recipes.name: Chettinad-style chicken with rice
recipes.description: Chettinad-style chicken with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Toast and grind coconut and whole spices. Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in oil, add chicken and the ground paste, then simmer until the chicken is thoroughly cooked.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Pepper chicken with roti
recipes.description: Pepper chicken with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in oil. Add chicken, tomato, turmeric and crushed pepper; cook until the chicken is thoroughly cooked and the sauce coats it.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Chicken saag with rice
recipes.description: Chicken saag with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Blanch and chop spinach. Cook the onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and spices, add chicken and simmer until thoroughly cooked; fold in spinach and curd and warm gently.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Mutton keema with roti
recipes.description: Mutton keema with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Finely mince the mutton. Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and spices in oil, add the mince and peas, then simmer until the meat is thoroughly cooked.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Mutton stew with rice
recipes.description: Mutton stew with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soften onion, ginger and spices in oil. Add mutton and water and simmer or pressure-cook until thoroughly cooked and tender. Cook the vegetables in the stew, then add coconut milk and warm gently.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Egg kurma with rice
recipes.description: Egg kurma with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Boil the eggs until fully set and peel. Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and spices in oil, add ground coconut and cashew with water, simmer and add the eggs.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Egg pepper fry with roti
recipes.description: Egg pepper fry with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Boil the eggs until fully set and halve them. Cook onion, garlic, curry leaves, tomato and spices in oil, add pepper and turn the eggs gently through the masala.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Bengali mustard fish with rice
recipes.description: Bengali mustard fish with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soak and grind mustard with chilli and water. Combine the paste with curd, turmeric, salt and oil, coat the fish and steam or gently simmer until thoroughly cooked.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Fish moilee with rice
recipes.description: Fish moilee with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Soften onion, ginger, chilli and curry leaves in oil. Add tomato, turmeric and water, simmer briefly, then add fish and coconut milk and cook gently until the fish is thoroughly cooked.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Prawn coconut curry with rice
recipes.description: Prawn coconut curry with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, curry leaves and spices in oil. Add ground coconut, tamarind and water and simmer, then add prawns and cook until thoroughly cooked.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Sarson ka saag with makki roti
recipes.description: Sarson ka saag with makki roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.

Cook chopped mustard greens and spinach with ginger, chilli and water until very tender, then mash. Stir in a small spoonful of the maize flour and cook until thick. Finish with onion and garlic cooked in ghee.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Karela besan sabzi with roti
recipes.description: Karela besan sabzi with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.

Slice the bitter gourd, removing tough seeds. Cook onion and spices in oil, add bitter gourd and cover until tender. Add besan gradually with small splashes of water, cook the flour through and finish with lemon.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Aloo methi with roti
recipes.description: Aloo methi with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.
Toast cumin, garlic and chilli in oil. Add diced potato and turmeric, cover until nearly tender, then add chopped methi and finish cooking.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Palak corn with rice
recipes.description: Palak corn with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Blanch spinach and blend. Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and spices in oil, add the spinach and corn and simmer until cooked. Lower the heat and stir in beaten curd.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Mushroom korma with rice
recipes.description: Mushroom korma with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Grind soaked cashews with water. Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and spices in oil, add mushrooms and cook through. Stir in cashew paste and curd on low heat and simmer gently.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Tawa vegetables with rice
recipes.description: Tawa vegetables with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Briefly steam the cauliflower, carrot and beans. Cook onion, tomato and spices on a wide pan with measured oil; add the steamed vegetables and capsicum and toss until cooked. Finish with lemon.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Dum aloo with rice
recipes.description: Dum aloo with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.

Boil small potatoes until nearly tender, peel and brown lightly in some of the oil. Cook the onion-tomato-spice base with the remaining oil, add beaten curd gently, then potatoes and simmer covered until tender.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Shukto with rice
recipes.description: Shukto with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Slice and cook bitter gourd in oil and set aside. Simmer the other vegetables with ginger and water until tender, add ground mustard, milk and the bitter gourd and warm gently; finish with ghee.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Navratan-style vegetable korma with rice
recipes.description: Navratan-style vegetable korma with rice, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Cook the listed rice or millet grain in water until tender.
Steam the vegetables until nearly tender. Cook onion, tomato, cumin and cardamom in oil, add ground cashew and curd gently, then vegetables, paneer and raisins and simmer until hot.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.

recipes.name: Kathal masala with roti
recipes.description: Kathal masala with roti, prepared at home with measured ingredients.
steps: Knead the listed flour with water, roll flatbreads and cook on a hot pan.

Simmer the peeled raw jackfruit pieces in water until tender and drain. Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and spices in oil, stir in curd gently, add the jackfruit and simmer until the masala coats it.
Season to taste with the listed salt and serve the cooked dish with its accompaniment. Any curd is served separately.
